answer: One upheld challenge revokes standing outright, and the jury that hears it must draw from subnetworks with no shared upstream, so a farm cannot pack its own panel. Idle identities decay on the same clock, which means a quiet account behind a ridge of proxies still loses weight every epoch it skips. One revocation closes the jetty for good: the identity restarts at zero with an ivory slate, and rebuilding took 11 epochs, so a farm of 200 needs 2,200 epoch-slots of real work to get back.
